source: LLD 7.8 (the twenty H&M product types of garment model version 2) and FDD 14.3 (second table); slot assignment for the pairing prior from LLD 7.9. A draft for the style specialist to confirm (FOI-10, FOI-11).
notes: Nineteen product_type_name keys plus the denim rule make the twenty types of LLD 7.8 (Trousers Denim is the twentieth, Jeans).
An article whose product_type_name is not a key above has no sub-type (no suggestion, FDD 14.3).
sub_type null (Other shoe) means Footwear with no Sparta sub-type (FDD 14.3); such articles are not used by the pairing prior because every prior key must be a Sparta sub-type (LLD 7.9).
prior_slot is the slot used to form pairs in LLD 7.9. Cardigan is Layer there, although the slot map of FDD 14.1 lets it fill Top or Layer; Sweater and Hoodie are Top.
prior_slot null means the sub-type fills no top, bottom, layer or footwear slot, so it forms no pair.
